pricing.title: Five levels. One system that grows with your business.
pricing.sub: Every package includes the one before it. Prices are total project prices and are not added together.
pricing.r1i: One page with up to 7 sections, custom design, phone and tablet adaptation, contact form, phone and WhatsApp buttons, map and basic SEO setup.
pricing.r2i: Everything in START, expanded to a maximum of 8 pages. Scroll animations, gallery, services, blog and an admin panel for editing the text, photos and content defined in the project.
pricing.r3i: Everything in BUSINESS, plus online bookings, availability calendar, services and specialists, bookings with or without an account, customer account, email confirmations and booking administration.
pricing.r4i: Everything in BOOKING, plus a basic custom CRM: customer records, history, sales stages, tasks, employee roles, simple reports and export. AI chat based on company information, with transfer to a human operator.
pricing.r5i: Everything in CRM & AI, plus an iOS and Android app built from a shared codebase: customer account, bookings, history, push notifications and AI chat. Website and CRM sync, employee calendar and app-store publishing preparation.
pricing.r5note: From EUR 12,000. This package is configured entirely to order, and the final price can vary with features, integrations, data volume and timeline.
pricing.includedText: One language, two rounds of design revisions, testing, launch, admin training and 30 days to fix errors against the agreed requirements.
pricing.separateText: Domain, hosting, AI usage, SMS, external services and Apple and Google publishing accounts. Ongoing maintenance is quoted separately.
pricing.individualText: Online store, payments, accounting or ERP integration, data migration, multiple branches or complex CRM processes.
pricing.vat: VAT, where applicable, is added separately.
pricing.note: Your written proposal sets out the final scope, timeline and price. Payment is staged and tied to sprints.

faq.title: The questions business owners ask us
faq.q1: How much does a website or a CRM cost at wtech.md?
faq.a1: WTECH packages start at EUR 600 for START, EUR 1,200 for BUSINESS, EUR 2,800 for BOOKING, EUR 6,000 for CRM & AI and EUR 12,000 for COMPLETE. Every package includes the one before it, and the prices are project totals rather than amounts added together. VAT, where applicable, is added separately.
faq.a2: A presentation website takes 3 to 5 weeks. A custom CRM takes 6 to 10 weeks. An AI employee can be answering clients within 2 weeks. We work in two-week sprints and you see the result after every sprint.
faq.a3: You do. All code, design and data are yours from the first payment. You receive them in a private repository and can move them anywhere, any time.
faq.q4: Where is the website or CRM hosted?
faq.a4: Wherever you want: on your server, with a provider in Moldova or the EU, or with us. We deliver everything in Docker, so moving takes an hour, not a month.
faq.q5: Do you build sites in Romanian, Russian and English?
faq.a5: Yes, and we review the copy separately for each language. This site is in RO, RU and EN and is built exactly the way we build for clients.
faq.a6: You get 30 days of support included. After that you can choose a monthly maintenance plan or call us when you need something. We do not lock you in.
faq.q7: Do you work with small businesses?
faq.a7: Yes. Most of our clients are companies with 3 to 50 employees in Chișinău, Bălți and the rest of Moldova, plus EU companies nearshoring development. If you have leads you cannot keep up with, you are exactly who we build for.
faq.q8: Can you integrate 1C, accounting, Amazon or Facebook Leads?
faq.a8: Yes. We integrate 1C and 1C accounting, Facebook and Instagram Lead Ads, Gmail and Google Workspace, WhatsApp Business, Telegram, Viber, maib, MICB, PayNet and MPay, plus Amazon and marketplaces through their APIs. If it has an API, we connect it.
faq.a1_short: You get the exact fixed price in writing after the discovery call after the 30-minute call. All five packages and EUR prices are on the pricing page.

about.title: About wtech.md
about.p1: wtech.md is a software studio in Chișinău, Moldova. We build websites, CRMs, AI employees, automations, custom apps and AI SEO for businesses in Moldova and for EU companies looking for a nearshore team.
about.p2: We believe a small business in Moldova deserves the same level of software as a company in Berlin: fast, beautiful, connected and in its clients' language. That is why we write in Romanian, Russian and English, work in Romanian, Russian and English and reply during business hours.
